text:
Nina: heads-up i've started a migration guide PR to update audit export examples for the v2 SDKs and clarify SOC2-friendly wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1122
Carlos: nice. does this change any API param names? we renamed `range` to `time_window` in the new SDKs last sprint.
Nina: yes — examples now use `time_window`. i've included curl, python, node, and go snippets. want to validate the phrasing about pseudonymization before i loop in legal.
Carlos: can you paste the node snippet? quick sanity check.
Nina: sure:
```js
// node v2 SDK example
const { Audit } = require('@redwood/inference');
const audit = new Audit({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await audit.exportEvidence({ tenantId: 'acme-123', pseudonymize: true, time_window: {from: '2025-04-01', to: '2025-04-30'} });
```
Nina: and go snippet:
```go
client.ExportEvidence(context.Background(), ExportParams{TenantID: "acme-123", Pseudonymize: true, TimeWindow: TimeRange{From: "2025-04-01", To: "2025-04-30"}})
```
Nina: proposed wording: "Identifiers are pseudonymized in exports; timestamps and audit metadata are retained for evidentiary purposes."
legal-ops: prefer "Identifiers are pseudonymized (irreversible hashing). Timestamps and audit metadata are retained." Also request we avoid the word "mask" alone — SOC2 reviewers liked explicit "irreversible" term.
Carlos: noted. i'll update the SDK examples to show `pseudonymized_user_id` in the sample JSON payload so downstreams see the field mapping.
Nina: added a short table mapping original fields -> exported fields (user_id -> pseudonymized_user_id, email -> pseudonymized_email). also linked to the retention TTL table and added a sentence: "Exports respect tenant (customer-owned namespace) retention settings; legal hold overrides are documented in the ops runbook."
devex-bot: Reminder: docs checklist 1 — add CODEOWNERS, add snippet unit tests, run link-checker, update changelog.
Nina: CODEOWNERS added, snippet tests included that assert field names and top-level keys. i'll ping for legal sign-off and one more review from devex before merger.
legal-ops: approved the new phrasing for SOC2. one tiny ask: replace ambiguous uses of "customer data" with "customer-controlled data" where relevant.
Nina: will do. merging after devex review. thanks everyone :rocket:
